title: tau2-telecom DtD v5f: registered blind evaluation on draw 3
why_v5f: Diagnosis of v5e on the spent draws 1-2 and train-split logs (no reserve task outside draws 0-2 was read): 87-89% of Qwen + v5e's LLM turns came after every check had been sent while the customer still reported a failure, usually because the tracker had discarded a fault the customer reported (v5e's message-wide 'fix done' regex fired on any 'reset'/'turned' and dropped every fault report in the message; 74 of 164 misses), or because a reply without a result ('let me check that first') was taken as a result. v5f reads fault evidence from every customer message clause by clause, sends the matching fix (at most twice per fault; app permissions with the missing names; a restart after an APN reset), re-asks a step answered without a result once, stops bundling after a customer refuses two steps, and, when every check has been sent and the problem persists, asks for the readouts that reveal the remaining fault before handing the turn to the LLM. No task-id logic. The optional LLM loop breaker from the diagnosis is NOT included.
development_check: 60 train-split tasks (seeded sample, 45 MMS + 15 mobile data), Qwen agent and customer, thinking off: v5f 58/60 (0.32 calls per conversation on the 50 tasks both arms had finished) vs v5e 46/50 (2.68 calls). Development evidence only.
ablation_context: Unregistered draw-2 ablations run before this freeze: Qwen + v5e with a thinking LLM fallback solved 111 of the first 113 tasks finished; Qwen + v5e in the manual's order 103/114 and in random order 97/114 (fixed order 102/114).
customer: Qwen3.8-27B, temperature 0, as in every registered telecom run
arms: Qwen free (thinking off; tau2 llm_agent behaviour inside dtd_agent, mode free)
Qwen + v5f, fixed order, LLM fallback with thinking on (temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95)
Qwen with thinking + the controller's checklist in its prompt (strongest prompted baseline; secondary, may finish last)
Opus 5.5 alone (tau2 llm_agent via the claude -p shim)
primary: success of Qwen + v5f (fixed order, thinking off) vs Qwen free on draw 3 (paired by task; task-clustered bootstrap, 4000 resamples, seed 11); confirmed if the 95% interval excludes 0
targets_stated_in_advance: T1: Qwen + v5f (fixed order, thinking off) finishes within 5 points of Opus alone (point estimate of the paired difference >= -5.0 points)
T2: Qwen + v5f with the thinking fallback finishes within 2 points of Opus alone or better (point estimate >= -2.0 points)
T3: LLM calls per conversation: Qwen + v5f (thinking off) < 2.0; Opus + v5f < 1.0

forecasts.Qwen + v5f QMDP / POMDP: within 5 points of the fixed order

secondary: each v5f arm vs Qwen free
agent LLM calls, agent tokens (incl. thinking) and customer messages per conversation
reruns: episodes that end in an infrastructure error with no outcome are rerun once with the same code; counts reported per arm
reporting: every arm is reported whatever the result, in the paper's registration appendix
